headline: Former Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Alla Nani dies of cardiac arrest in Visakhapatnam; he was 56
content: VISAKHAPATNAM Former Deputy Chief Minister Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas, popularly known as Alla Nani, died of cardiac arrest in Visakhapatnam on Tuesday (September 15, 2026). He was 56. https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Visakhapatnam/ Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu said in a post on X that he was deeply shocked by the sudden death, and that it was heartbreaking that Mr. Alla Nani had died so young. He expressed his condolences to the family. ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్ర మాజీ ఉప ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఆళ్ల నాని గారి (కాళీ కృష్ణ శ్రీనివాస్) హఠాన్మరణం నాకు తీవ్ర దిగ్భ్రాంతి కలిగించింది. 56 సంవత్సరాల వయసులోనే గుండెపోటుతో ఆయన దూరమవ్వడం బాధాకరం. ఆయన కుటుంబానికి నా ప్రగాఢ సానుభూతి వ్యక్తం చేస్తున్నాను. ఆళ్ల నాని గారి ఆత్మకు శాంతిని… pic.twitter.com/IlA7QrLDXP— N Chandrababu Naidu (@ncbn) September 15, 2026 Born in Sanivarapu Peta in Eluru on December 30, 1969, he won the town’s Assembly seat for the Congress in 2004 and 2009, quit the party in 2012 and joined the YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) the next year. He lost Eluru in 2014, entered the Legislative Council in 2017 and won the seat back in 2019. https://www.thehindu.com/topic/yuvajana-sramika-rythu-congress-party/ He was Deputy Chief Minister and Minister for Health, Family Welfare and Medical Education from June 2019 to April 2022, holding the health portfolio through the COVID-19 pandemic until the Cabinet was reshuffled. He lost Eluru in 2024 by over 62,000 votes, resigned from the YSRCP on August 9 that year saying he was leaving politics, and joined the Telugu Desam Party in February 2025. YSRCP president Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, in whose Cabinet Mr. Alla Nani served, said he was deeply shocked and shaken by the death, the party said in a post on X. He recalled his three terms as Eluru MLA and his service as Deputy Chief Minister and Health Minister, and called the death an irreparable loss to the family and to his admirers. ఆళ్లనాని గారి ఆకస్మిక మృతిపై వైయస్‌.జగన్‌ గారు దిగ్భ్రాంతి, ప్రగాఢ సానుభూతిమాజీ డిప్యూటీ సీఎం, ఏలూరు మాజీ శాసనసభ్యుడు, టీడీపీ నాయకుడు ఆళ్ల కాళీకృష్ణ శ్రీనివాస్‌ (నాని) గారి మృతిపట్ల మాజీ ముఖ్యమంత్రి శ్రీ వైయస్‌.జగన్ గారు తీవ్ర దిగ్భ్రాంతి వ్యక్తంచేశారు. ఆయన మృతి తనను… pic.twitter.com/rExFHOND2i— YSR Congress Party (@YSRCParty) September 15, 2026 Former Rajya Sabha member V. Vijayasai Reddy also condoled the death. “His dedicated public service and contribution to the state will always be remembered,” he wrote on X. Deeply saddened by the passing of Shri Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas (Alla Nani), former Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh. His dedicated public service and contribution to the state will always be remembered. Heartfelt condolences to his family, supporters and admirers.
